arStrings.szText: "Do not touch it, Aidan. You have done enough. Let me take it."
He was my responsibility. From the moment he was born, Father said so. (sighs) I taught him to ride, to fence...but he was always too gentle. Ohh, I loved him for it.
Very well. Take that accursed stone. And I will take care of him, one last time.
Thank you, wanderer. Good luck to you.
